summary: All five genes labeled as upregulated in the authors’ stress-versus-control PVN plot have positive registered coefficients. Four meet the paper’s fold-change and nominal-P cutoffs locally. Clec7a falls below the fold-change cutoff. This closes the five-symbol direction comparison without full verification. [Figure 4A and study methods](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11808488/)
openIssues: The full author edgeR table was unavailable. Exact effect sizes, per-gene P values, FDR and genome-wide overlap remain unassessed. Five published directions fall below the 30-pair concordance minimum.
Two deposited Ensembl IDs carry the Hmgb2 label. Figure 4A identifies the symbol only, so the underlying author feature remains unresolved.
